title: Noetherian Cohen–Macaulay rings are universally catenary
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Assume that for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subseteq R$, the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is Cohen–Macaulay, meaning $\operatorname{depth}(R_{\mathfrak p})=\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})$ with depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] and Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $R$ is universally catenary [def-exc-excellent-ring]: every finite type commutative $R$-algebra $A$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] is catenary, so between any comparable primes of $A$ finite strict prime-chain lengths have a finite upper bound and all saturated chains have the same length.

source.place: Tag 00NM, lemma-CM-ring-catenary: a Noetherian Cohen–Macaulay ring is universally catenary; the proof applies the polynomial-algebra Cohen–Macaulay result and the maximal-chain formula.
